description_en: Starts one or more nodes in a cluster
description_zh: 调用StartNodes启动集群中的一个或多个节点
kebab_example: aliyun ehpc start-nodes --cluster-id ehpc-hz-FYUr320000 --instance Id=i-bp13p7vlcb1uihfv0000 --api-version 2018-04-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: StartNodes

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the cluster.

Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html to obtain the cluster ID
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html获取集群ID
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The role of the nodes. Valid values:

Manager: management node
Login: logon node
Compute: compute node

Default value: Compute
parameters.help_zh:
节点角色。取值范围：
Manager：管控节点
Login：登录节点
Compute：计算节点

默认值：Compute
parameters.name: role

fields.help_en:
The instance ID of the node to start. You can specify up to 100 nodes.

Ensure that the node is in the Stopped state. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87161.html to query the status of the node
fields.help_zh:
第N个要启动的节点的实例ID。N的取值范围：1~100

请确保节点状态必须为stopped（已停止），您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87161.html查询待启动节点的状态
fields.name: id

parameters.help_en: A list of nodes to start
parameters.help_zh: 要启动的节点信息列表
parameters.name: instance
